profile_overhaul_specifications.headline: Enterprise AI Architect | Custom MCP Servers, LangGraph & Autonomous Multi-Agent Systems
profile_overhaul_specifications.overview_copy:
Most businesses waste thousands trying to stitch together disconnected AI APIs and brittle chatbot wrappers.
I build resilient, enterprise-grade agentic infrastructure. As an AI Systems Architect, I design custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, autonomous multi-agent pipelines, and secure local LLM environments that seamlessly integrate your internal tools with leading foundation models.
Core Architecture Capabilities:
* Custom MCP Server Engineering: Connecting enterprise databases, private APIs, and custom CRM systems directly to Claude Code, Cursor, and enterprise agents via official Model Context Protocol standards (OAuth 2.1, SSE, STDIO). * Multi-Agent Autonomous Orchestration: Architecting resilient multi-agent teams using LangGraph, CrewAI, and custom execution loops with human-in-the-loop oversight and state persistence. * Zero-Leakage Local LLM & RAG Systems: On-premise and VPC-isolated model deployments (Llama 3, Mistral, vLLM, Qdrant) designed for strict healthcare, legal, and enterprise compliance. * Enterprise Tooling & Agent Plugins: Turnkey workflows that automate complex workflows, data extraction, and operational pipelines without human hand-holding.
Engagement Models:
1. Done-For-You Architecture & Implementation: End-to-end production development, infrastructure deployment, testing, and team handoff. 2. Technical Feasibility & Architecture Consultations: 60-minute roadmap sessions to audit your stack, identify failure points, and draft execution blueprints before writing code. 3. Turnkey Templates & Starter Kits: Pre-built, production-tested MCP server starter boilerplates and agent skills collections available in my Project Catalog.
If you require production-grade AI systems built with architectural rigor, book a consultation or send a message with your project brief.
